name: meli_category_detail
description:
Qualitative snapshot of one MercadoLibre category for one month: High/Medium/Low levels of opportunity, growth, saturation, catalog and volume; average price and its change versus the previous month; the best and worst sales months with their events; the share of listings with free shipping, Mercado Envíos, catalog and discount; and how sales split by seller medal.

Use when: the user wants to judge a category's health or competitive pressure before entering it, or needs its price level, logistics mix or seasonality peak.
Not for: revenue, units or top sellers — it returns none of them. Use nubi_category_market_size for revenue and units, and meli_market_rankings for who leads.
Requires: a category id or path — call meli_category_explorer if unknown.
Limitation: closed months only; if the requested month is the current one and has no data yet, it falls back to the previous one (period_fallback=true, period_applied says which month).
Note: data_available=false means the backend has no measurement for this category and month — data is null, not zero.

category_id.description: Category id or the full path from meli_category_explorer, e.g. 'MLA1246' or 'MLA1246-MLA1263-MLA414007'. A bare id is resolved to its full path. A hyphenated value is used as given, so pass the complete path — a partial or truncated path is not repaired and fails. Must belong to the seller's site (MLA, MLB, …).

date.description: First day of the month to read, e.g. 2026-09-01. Only closed months have data; if this is the current month and it has no data yet, the tool falls back to the previous month (see period_fallback).

currency.description: 'local' = site currency, 'usd' = US dollars. Only avg_price is an amount here; use 'usd' to compare prices across months without inflation.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to use. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts. Get the linked ids from nubi_user_info.

opportunity.description: Nubimetrics opportunity level: Low / Medium / High.

saturation.description: Competitive saturation level: Low / Medium / High.

catalg.description: Catalog penetration level: Low / Medium / High. (The field name's spelling comes from the backend.)

volume.description: Sales volume level: Low / Medium / High.

avgPrice.description: Average price in the category for the month, in 'currency'.

previousDate.description: Month the average price is compared against.

variation.description: Change of avgPrice versus previousDate, already in % (2.44 means 2.44%) — never multiply by 100.

priceVariation.description: Average price and its change versus a previous month.

date.description: Month of the historical sales peak.

events.description: Notable promotions in that month (e.g. Hot Sale). Often empty.

topSalesMilestone.description: Best sales month in the category's history and its events.

date.description: Month of the historical sales low.

events.description: Notable promotions in that month. Often empty.

lowSalesMilestone.description: Worst sales month in the category's history and its events.

siFreeShippingPercentage.description: % of the category's listings that offer free shipping. The base is all listings, not listings with sales.

siMercadoEnvioPercentage.description: % of the category's listings that use Mercado Envíos. The base is all listings.

siCatalogPercentage.description: % of the category's listings WITH SALES that compete in catalog — never % of units.

itemsDiscountPercentage.description: % of the category's listings with an active discount. The base is all listings.

platinum.description: % of the month's units sold by sellers with this medal; the four add up to 100. Not the share of sellers.

gold.description: % of the month's units sold by sellers with this medal; the four add up to 100. Not the share of sellers.

silver.description: % of the month's units sold by sellers with this medal; the four add up to 100. Not the share of sellers.

normal.description: % of the month's units sold by sellers with this medal; the four add up to 100. Not the share of sellers.

saturationRates.description: How the month's units sold split by seller medal; the four values add up to 100.

data.description: Category readings for period_applied. null when data_available is false.

data_available.description: False when there is no data for this category/month — data is null. Do not report metrics as zero; tell the user data is unavailable for this query instead.

currency.description: ISO code of avgPrice: the site's currency, or USD when currency='usd'.

period_applied.description: Month actually served (YYYY-MM-DD). Cite this one, not the requested month.

period_fallback.description: True when the requested month had no data and period_applied is the previous month.

name: meli_category_explorer
description:
Lists MercadoLibre leaf categories with market-wide indicators, to compare categories or to find a category's path before calling a category tool.

Figures are monthly averages over the last 12 closed months, except growth_ytd and growth_yoy — there is no date parameter. The *_scoring fields are Nubimetrics 1–10 scores relative to the leaf categories of the same top-level branch (10 = highest in its branch), not to the whole site: they are not comparable across branches and are not percentages, amounts or ranking positions. To compare across branches use the raw figures (visits, sellers, successful_items, avg_ticket). growth_ytd (January to the last closed month vs the same months a year earlier) and growth_yoy (last closed month vs the same month a year earlier) are unit-sales growth, capped at 1000.

Use when: the user wants to discover or compare categories (competition, growth, visits, medal mix, peak and low month, sellers, ticket), or you need the 'path' of a category for meli_category_detail, meli_market_rankings, meli_search_trends_rankings, nubi_category_market_size, nubi_category_market_structure or nubi_category_forecast.
Not for: the seller's own performance — use nubi_evaluate_categories. For one month of one category use meli_category_detail; for a monthly series use nubi_category_market_size.
Note: results can include categories this account is not allowed to query — check the path against nubi_seller_info's allowed_categories before calling a category tool.
Note: 'total' is the size of the site's whole category tree, not the number of matches — count the returned rows instead.
Note: only_my_categories narrows to categories where the seller has listings; for an account with none it returns the whole site.
Caution: fetch_all=true loads the whole tree (~10K rows) with many requests — prefer search_term, category_id_l1 or the min_/max_ filters.

sort_by.description: Metric to order by, named after the output field's backend source: avgSuccessfulItemsScoring=scoring, avgGmvScoring=gmv_scoring, avgCompetitivityScoring=competitivity, avgVisitsScoring=visits_scoring, avgSuccessfulListingsScoring=listings_scoring, avgItemQuantityScoring=item_quantity_scoring, avgCatalogSiPercentageScoring=catalog_scoring, ytdSiVariation=growth_ytd, yoYSiVariation=growth_yoy, avgVisits=visits, avgSellers=sellers, avgTicketLocal=avg_ticket, avgSiSellers<Medal>Percentage=saturation_<medal>. The *_scoring fields order by the score within the top-level branch, so combine them with category_id_l1; across branches order by a raw figure instead. Do not use hasSales: the backend returns an empty list with it.

order_by.description: Sort direction. Use asc with competitivity to list the least competitive categories first.

only_my_categories.description: If true, only the categories the seller operates in. Values are still market-wide. For an account with no categories of its own it returns the whole site.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Ignored when fetch_all=true.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Ignored when fetch_all=true.

fetch_all.description: Fetch every page in one call, with the same search and filters. Without filters this is the whole site (~10K rows) and is slow — use it only for exhaustive comparisons, or to get a seller's complete list with only_my_categories.

search_term.description: Substring match over the category's full name (e.g. 'Cafeteras', 'Zapatillas'). Use one or two short nouns that appear in a category name — product phrases rarely match. If nothing comes back, retry once with a shorter or broader noun. Combines with sort_by and the filters.

category_id_l1.description: Top-level category ID, e.g. 'MLA5726' — restricts results to that branch. It is the first segment of a category path.

min_sellers.description: Lower bound on the output 'sellers' field, inclusive.

max_sellers.description: Upper bound on the output 'sellers' field, inclusive.

min_avg_ticket.description: Lower bound on 'avg_ticket', inclusive, in the site's local currency.

max_avg_ticket.description: Upper bound on 'avg_ticket', inclusive, in the site's local currency.

min_visits.description: Lower bound on the output 'visits' field (monthly average), inclusive.

max_visits.description: Upper bound on the output 'visits' field (monthly average), inclusive.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to use. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts. Get the linked ids from nubi_user_info.

name.description: Full category name from top level to leaf, joined by '-', e.g. 'Ropa y Accesorios-Calzado-Zapatillas'.

path.description: Category ids from top level to leaf joined by '-'. Pass it as category_id to the category tools; its last segment is the leaf id meli_publication_explorer takes.

scoring.description: 1–10 score of the units sold, relative to the leaf categories of the same top-level branch (10 = highest in its branch). Not comparable across branches: a 10 in a small branch can be small site-wide. Linear min-max scale, so most categories sit near 1: a low score means far from the branch's top category, not a poor one. Not a percentage, an amount or a position.

gmv_scoring.description: 1–10 score of the category's revenue, relative to the leaf categories of the same top-level branch (10 = highest in its branch). Not comparable across branches: a 10 in a small branch can be small site-wide. Linear min-max scale, so most categories sit near 1: a low score means far from the branch's top category, not a poor one. Not a percentage, an amount or a position.

visits_scoring.description: 1–10 score of the category's visits, relative to the leaf categories of the same top-level branch (10 = highest in its branch). Not comparable across branches: a 10 in a small branch can be small site-wide. Linear min-max scale, so most categories sit near 1: a low score means far from the branch's top category, not a poor one. Not a percentage, an amount or a position.

listings_scoring.description: 1–10 score of the number of listings with sales, relative to the leaf categories of the same top-level branch (10 = highest in its branch). Not comparable across branches: a 10 in a small branch can be small site-wide. Linear min-max scale, so most categories sit near 1: a low score means far from the branch's top category, not a poor one. Not a percentage, an amount or a position.

item_quantity_scoring.description: 1–10 score of the number of offered (active) listings, relative to the leaf categories of the same top-level branch (10 = highest in its branch). Not comparable across branches: a 10 in a small branch can be small site-wide. Linear min-max scale, so most categories sit near 1: a low score means far from the branch's top category, not a poor one. Not a percentage, an amount or a position.

catalog_scoring.description: 1–10 score of the share of sales made through catalog listings, relative to the leaf categories of the same top-level branch (10 = highest in its branch). Not comparable across branches: a 10 in a small branch can be small site-wide. Linear min-max scale, so most categories sit near 1: a low score means far from the branch's top category, not a poor one. Not a percentage, an amount or a position.

growth_ytd.description: Units sold from January to the last closed month of the current year versus the same months of the previous year, in %. Capped at 1000: a value of 1000 means '1000% or more', not an exact figure.

growth_yoy.description: Units sold in the last closed month versus the same month of the previous year, in % (whole numbers). Not revenue growth and not a 12-month comparison. Capped at 1000: a value of 1000 means '1000% or more', not an exact figure.

visits.description: Average monthly visits to the category over the last 12 closed months — not a period total and not a 1–10 score.

competitivity.description: 1–10 score of competition, relative to the leaf categories of the same top-level branch (10 = highest in its branch). Not comparable across branches: a 10 in a small branch can be small site-wide. Linear min-max scale, so most categories sit near 1: a low score means far from the branch's top category, not a poor one. Not a percentage, an amount or a position. Higher means more competition. A score, not the raw competitiveness index.

has_sales.description: True when the category is one of the seller's own and the seller meets Nubimetrics' sales minimum in its top-level category (at least 10 sales and over USD 300 in the last 90 days). Not tied to the data's period. The metrics in this tool are market-wide and come filled either way.

saturation_platinum.description: % of the category's units sold by sellers with this MercadoLibre medal, 12-month average, rounded to whole numbers; the four add up to about 100. Not the share of sellers.

saturation_gold.description: % of the category's units sold by sellers with this MercadoLibre medal, 12-month average, rounded to whole numbers; the four add up to about 100. Not the share of sellers.

saturation_silver.description: % of the category's units sold by sellers with this MercadoLibre medal, 12-month average, rounded to whole numbers; the four add up to about 100. Not the share of sellers.

saturation_normal.description: % of the category's units sold by sellers with this MercadoLibre medal, 12-month average, rounded to whole numbers; the four add up to about 100. Not the share of sellers.

peak_month.description: Month with the most units sold within the 12-month window, as an ISO date (first day of the month, e.g. '2026-05-01T00:00:00Z'). Not the latest month.

low_month.description: Month with the fewest units sold within the 12-month window, as an ISO date.

sellers.description: Average monthly number of active sellers.

successful_items.description: Average monthly number of listings with at least one sale — never units sold.

avg_ticket.description: Average revenue per unit sold, in the site's local currency (revenue / units sold). Not the value of an order. Always an amount.

total.description: Size of the site's whole category tree — NOT the number of matches. Count the rows of 'categories' instead.

page_size.description: Page size requested (echo of the input). With fetch_all=true, all rows come back regardless.

name: nubi_category_forecast
description:
Demand forecast for one MercadoLibre category: one projected point per month for the 12 months after period_applied (the requested month, or the previous one on fallback) — units and revenue (local and USD), each with its growth versus the same month of the previous year, plus the previous year's local-currency revenue for that month — and a summary for the whole calendar year (actual closed months plus projected ones).

Use when: the user asks about expected demand, future size or seasonality ahead for a category.
Requires: a category id or path — call meli_category_explorer if unknown — and date = first day of the last closed month.
Note: is_generated=false means there is no forecast model for that category — projection is empty and the accumulated_annual zeros are not real values.
Note: projections are model estimates, not measurements.
Note: not available for B2C accounts — the call is rejected whatever the category.

category_id.description: Category id or the full path from meli_category_explorer, e.g. 'MLA1246' or 'MLA1246-MLA1263-MLA414007'. A bare id is resolved to its full path. A hyphenated value is used as given, so pass the complete path — a partial or truncated path is not repaired and fails. Must belong to the seller's site (MLA, MLB, …).

date.description: First day of the last CLOSED month, e.g. 2026-05-01 if today is June. The tool falls back to the previous month automatically if the requested month has no data yet. The projection starts the month after period_applied.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to use. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts. Get the linked ids from nubi_user_info.

is_generated.description: False when there is no forecast model for this category — all numeric fields will be zero.

category.description: Leaf category id the forecast belongs to.

currency.description: ISO currency code for all local-currency fields (e.g. MXN, ARS, BRL).

period_applied.description: Reference month actually used (YYYY-MM-DD). May differ from the requested date when period_fallback=true.

period_fallback.description: True when the requested month had no closed data and the previous month was used instead.

successful_items_ytd.description: Units for the whole year: actual closed months plus projected months.

successful_items_growth_ytd.description: Change of that year total versus the whole previous calendar year, in %.

gmv_usd_forecasted_ytd.description: Same total in USD; actual months are converted with the forecast's own exchange rate.

gmv_local_forecasted_ytd.description: Revenue for the whole year in local currency: actual closed months plus projected months.

gmv_usd_growth_ytd.description: Change of that year total versus the whole previous calendar year, in %.

gmv_local_growth_ytd.description: Change of that year total versus the whole previous calendar year, in % — includes inflation; compare with the USD figure.

accumulated_annual.description: Totals for the whole calendar year of period_applied, up to date_ytd: actual closed months plus projected months.

projection.description: One point per month for the 12 months after period_applied, oldest first.

successful_items_growth_yoy.description: Projected units versus the same month of the previous year, in %.

gmv_usd_forecasted.description: Projected revenue for the month, in USD.

gmv_local_forecasted.description: Projected revenue for the month, in local currency.

gmv_usd_growth_yoy.description: Projected USD revenue versus the same month of the previous year, in %.

gmv_local_growth_yoy.description: Projected local revenue versus the same month of the previous year, in %.

gmv_local_before_forecasted.description: Actual GMV in local currency for the same month in the prior year — the baseline used to compute gmv_local_growth_yoy.

name: nubi_category_market_size
description:
Monthly series for one MercadoLibre category over a month range: revenue and average ticket (each in local currency and in USD) and units sold, with every point carrying the same month of the previous year; plus the averages of each series.

Use when: the user asks how big a category is or how its revenue and units evolved, including year-over-year.
Not for: counting sellers or listings — use nubi_category_market_structure.
Requires: a category id or path — call meli_category_explorer if unknown.
Note: data_available=false means no measurement for that category and range — the zeros are not real values.
Note: this backend checks category access from a different source than nubi_seller_info, so a category listed there as allowed can still be rejected here. A rejection is stable, not a transient error — do not retry.
Note: not available for B2C accounts — the call is rejected whatever the category.

category_id.description: Category id or the full path from meli_category_explorer, e.g. 'MLA1246' or 'MLA1246-MLA1263-MLA414007'. A bare id is resolved to its full path. A hyphenated value is used as given, so pass the complete path — a partial or truncated path is not repaired and fails. Must belong to the seller's site (MLA, MLB, …).

date_from.description: First day of the starting month, e.g. 2025-05-01.

date_to.description: First day of the ending month, e.g. 2026-05-01. Inclusive — this month is returned.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to use. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts. Get the linked ids from nubi_user_info.

category_id.description: Category as passed in the request.

currency.description: ISO code of the *_local series (the site's currency).

date_from.description: Requested month range, both months included.

date_to.description: Requested month range, both months included.

data_available.description: False when there is no data for this category/date range — all numeric fields below are 0, not a real measurement. Do not report them as actual zeros; tell the user data is unavailable for this query instead.

gmv_local.description: Monthly revenue in local currency, one point per month — read each point's date.

date.description: Month of the point (ISO date, first day of the month).

value.description: Value of the series in that month.

previous_period_value.description: Same month in the prior year — enables direct YoY comparison.

previous_period_date.description: Date of the prior-year reference point.

gmv_usd.description: Monthly revenue in USD, one point per month.

date.description: Month of the point (ISO date, first day of the month).

value.description: Value of the series in that month.

previous_period_value.description: Same month in the prior year — enables direct YoY comparison.

previous_period_date.description: Date of the prior-year reference point.

successful_items.description: Monthly units sold, one point per month.

date.description: Month of the point (ISO date, first day of the month).

value.description: Value of the series in that month.

previous_period_value.description: Same month in the prior year — enables direct YoY comparison.

previous_period_date.description: Date of the prior-year reference point.

avg_ticket_local.description: Monthly average ticket (revenue per sale) in local currency.

date.description: Month of the point (ISO date, first day of the month).

value.description: Value of the series in that month.

previous_period_value.description: Same month in the prior year — enables direct YoY comparison.

previous_period_date.description: Date of the prior-year reference point.

date.description: Month of the point (ISO date, first day of the month).

value.description: Value of the series in that month.

previous_period_value.description: Same month in the prior year — enables direct YoY comparison.

previous_period_date.description: Date of the prior-year reference point.

gmv_local.description: Average monthly value of that series over the range.

gmv_local_previous.description: Same average over the same months one year earlier.

gmv_usd.description: Average monthly value of that series over the range.

gmv_usd_previous.description: Same average over the same months one year earlier.

successful_items.description: Average monthly value of that series over the range.

successful_items_previous.description: Same average over the same months one year earlier.

avg_ticket_local.description: Average monthly value of that series over the range.

avg_ticket_local_previous.description: Same average over the same months one year earlier.

avg_ticket_usd.description: Average monthly value of that series over the range.

avg_ticket_usd_previous.description: Same average over the same months one year earlier.

averages.description: Average of each series over the range, with its prior-year counterpart (*_previous).

name: nubi_category_market_structure
description:
Monthly series for one MercadoLibre category over a month range: active sellers, professional sellers and listings, with every point carrying the same month of the previous year; plus the averages of each series.

Use when: the user asks how many sellers or listings compete in a category and how that changed.
Not for: visits — this backend never returns them; use meli_category_explorer. Not for revenue or units — use nubi_category_market_size.
Requires: a category id or path — call meli_category_explorer if unknown.
Note: data_available=false means no measurement for that category and range — the zeros are not real values.
Note: category access is checked from a different source than nubi_seller_info; a rejection is stable, do not retry.
Note: not available for B2C accounts — the call is rejected whatever the category.

category_id.description: Category id or the full path from meli_category_explorer, e.g. 'MLA1246' or 'MLA1246-MLA1263-MLA414007'. A bare id is resolved to its full path. A hyphenated value is used as given, so pass the complete path — a partial or truncated path is not repaired and fails. Must belong to the seller's site (MLA, MLB, …).

date_from.description: First day of the starting month, e.g. 2025-05-01.

date_to.description: First day of the ending month, e.g. 2026-05-01. Inclusive — this month is returned.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to use. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts. Get the linked ids from nubi_user_info.

category_id.description: Category as passed in the request.

date_from.description: Requested month range, both months included.

date_to.description: Requested month range, both months included.

data_available.description: False when there is no data for this category/date range — all numeric fields below are 0, not a real measurement. Do not report them as actual zeros; tell the user data is unavailable for this query instead.

visits.description: Always empty — this backend returns no visits. Use meli_category_explorer for visits.

sellers.description: Active sellers, one point per month — read each point's date.

value.description: Value of the series in that month.

previous_period_value.description: Same month in the prior year.

value.description: Value of the series in that month.

previous_period_value.description: Same month in the prior year.

value.description: Value of the series in that month.

previous_period_value.description: Same month in the prior year.

successful_listings.description: Currently identical to 'listings' — not a count of listings with sales.

value.description: Value of the series in that month.

previous_period_value.description: Same month in the prior year.

sellers.description: Average monthly value of that series over the range.

sellers_professional.description: Average monthly value of that series over the range.

listings.description: Average monthly value of that series over the range.

successful_listings.description: Average monthly value of that series over the range.

averages.description: Average of each series over the range, with *_previous for the prior year.

name: nubi_competition_publication_detail
description:
Snapshot of one followed publication: title, seller, official store, category path, price, original price and discount, condition, status, Full/Flex/catalog/free-shipping flags, listing type, brand, model, SKU and last update; plus revenue, units, visits, conversion and questions over a day window ending today.

Use when: the user wants the current state and recent performance of one followed publication.
Requires: member_code and member_owner from nubi_competition_publication_group_members.
Note: gmv and units are rounded display strings such as '1.2M'. For a daily series use nubi_competition_publication_evolution; for its change history use nubi_competition_publication_log.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

member_owner.description: Obfuscated hash of the seller who owns this publication, from nubi_competition_publication_group_members.

days.description: Size of the KPI/analysis window in days, counting back from today (inclusive). E.g. 30 = last 30 days, 90 = last 90 days. Any value in range works — not limited to a fixed set of buckets.

seller_nickname.description: Seller's display name; for competitors it is obfuscated (e.g. 'AVESTRUZ.LINO.RESPETUOSO').

owner_seller_id.description: Hash of the seller who owns this publication — distinct from the top-level seller_id parameter, which identifies the querying account.

official_store_id.description: Hashed official store id; null when the listing has none.

category_path.description: Full breadcrumb path from root, e.g. 'Accesorios para Vehículos/.../Camperas'. Not a category_id.

installments.description: Raw installments code (e.g. 'gsnq'); decoding not confirmed.

last_updated.description: When the listing data was last refreshed.

gmv.description: Revenue in the window, as a rounded display string.

units.description: Units sold in the window, as a display string.

data.description: Listing snapshot plus its KPIs for the day window.

name: nubi_competition_publication_evolution
description:
Daily series for one followed publication: revenue (gmv), units (si), price, visits and conversion.

Use when: the user wants to see how a followed publication evolved, or compare it with the previous period.
Requires: member_code and member_owner from nubi_competition_publication_group_members.
Note: with no data for the publication it returns no series. For a closed publication it returns only the requested window (5 series). Otherwise it returns the requested window (ending today, today included) and the previous window of the same length, 5 series each, with the names repeated — tell them apart by the dates of their points.
Note: points are strings 'YYYY-MM-DD value', ascending by date — split on the space.
Note: unlike nubi_competition_seller_evolution, this series has 'price' instead of 'items'.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

member_owner.description: Obfuscated hash of the seller who owns this publication, from nubi_competition_publication_group_members.

days.description: Size of the series window in days, counting back from today (inclusive). E.g. 30 = last 30 days, 90 = last 90 days. Any value in range works — not limited to a fixed set of buckets. The previous window of the same length is returned too (not for a closed publication), and today is included.

metrics.description: No series when there is no data for the publication; only the requested window (5 series) for a closed publication; otherwise the requested window and the previous window of the same length, 5 series each. Names repeat — tell the windows apart by the dates.

name.description: Series name: 'gmv', 'price', 'si', 'visits' or 'convertion' (twice when both windows are returned).

points.description: Points as 'YYYY-MM-DD value' strings, oldest first; the requested window includes today. 'convertion' values have 2 decimals; all other metrics are whole numbers.

currency.description: ISO code of the gmv and price series.

name: nubi_competition_publication_group_members
description:
Lists the publications inside one followed-publication group. Each one comes with two hashes that the publication tools need together: member_code (the publication) and member_owner (the seller who owns it).

Use when: you need to see which publications a group follows, or need member_code/member_owner for nubi_competition_publication_detail, nubi_competition_publication_evolution or nubi_competition_publication_log.
Requires: a group_id from nubi_competition_publication_groups.
Note: both values are obfuscated hashes, not MercadoLibre ids, and the output has no title — call nubi_competition_publication_detail for it.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

group_id.description: Group id exactly as returned by nubi_competition_publication_groups — never the group name or its position in the list.
Id of the group (echo of the input).

group_description.description: Description of the group; often empty.

is_favorite.description: True when the group is marked as favorite.

members.description: Publications in the group — the seller's own and competitors' can be mixed.

member_code.description: Obfuscated item hash. Use as member_code in nubi_competition_publication_evolution and nubi_competition_publication_detail.

member_owner.description: Obfuscated hash of the seller who owns this publication. Required as member_owner in nubi_competition_publication_detail.

active.description: True when the member is active in the group.

tracking_information.description: Backend tracking flag; its meaning is not documented.

has_more.description: True when more members are available with offset.

name: nubi_competition_publication_group_metrics
description:
Totals for a whole followed-publication group over a day window: combined revenue, units and visits, and the average price, plus the window's dates. One summary for the group, not a per-publication breakdown.

Use when: the user wants the overall activity of a followed-publication group.
Requires: a group_id from nubi_competition_publication_groups. For one publication use nubi_competition_publication_detail.
Note: days is an exact day count ending today. total_gmv and total_units are rounded display strings such as '1.2M'. avg_price is null when no member reports a price.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

group_id.description: Group id exactly as returned by nubi_competition_publication_groups — never the group name or its position in the list.

days.description: Size of the analysis window in days, counting back from today (inclusive). E.g. 30 = last 30 days, 90 = last 90 days. Any value in range works — not limited to a fixed set of buckets.

category_id.description: Restrict to one category id, e.g. 'MLA1051'. Empty string = all categories.

total_gmv.description: Sum of the publications' revenue in the window, as a rounded display string.

total_units.description: Sum of units, as a rounded display string.

total_visits.description: Sum of visits in the window.

avg_price.description: Simple (unweighted) average of the members' current prices. null when no member reports a price.

member_count.description: Publications with data that were added up.

currency.description: ISO code of the amounts: always the site's currency.

name: nubi_competition_publication_groups
description:
Lists the seller's saved groups of PUBLICATIONS they follow — each group can mix the seller's own listings and competitors' listings: group id, name, description, favorite flag and member count. The full list always includes the default 'Publicaciones Favoritas' group.

Use when: the user mentions followed or tracked publications, or you need a group_id for nubi_competition_publication_group_members or nubi_competition_publication_group_metrics.
Not for: groups of sellers — use nubi_competition_seller_groups.
Note: pass group_id exactly as returned, never the list position.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

group_id.description: Group id — pass it exactly as is to the members and metrics tools.

group_description.description: Description of the group; often empty.

is_favorite.description: True for the group marked as favorite.

has_more.description: True when more groups are available with offset.

name: nubi_competition_publication_log
description:
Full change history of one followed publication: one entry per change with its date, what changed (e.g. price, status, title) and the old and new values, newest first.

Use when: the user asks what changed on a followed publication and when — price moves, pauses, title edits.
Requires: member_code and member_owner from nubi_competition_publication_group_members.
Note: there is no date filter; it always returns the whole history. old_value and new_value are text even for prices.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

member_owner.description: Obfuscated hash of the seller who owns this publication, from nubi_competition_publication_group_members.

what_changed.description: Kind of change, e.g. 'Price change', 'Status change', 'Title change'.

old_value.description: Value before the change, as text (prices included).

new_value.description: Value after the change, as text.

total.description: Number of changes returned (the whole history).

name: nubi_competition_seller_evolution
description:
Daily series for one competitor over a day window: visits, revenue (gmv), units (si), items and conversion — one point per day, today excluded because it is still in progress.

Use when: the user asks how a competitor is trending.
Requires: seller_id_competitor from nubi_competition_seller_group_members. To compare several competitors call once per competitor.
Note: points are strings 'YYYY-MM-DD value', ascending by date — split on the space.
Note: unlike nubi_competition_publication_evolution, this series has 'items' instead of 'price' and does not include the previous period.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

seller_id_competitor.description: member_code of a competitor from nubi_competition_seller_group_members — an obfuscated hash, not a MercadoLibre id or nickname. Entries with is_self=true are rejected.

days.description: Size of the series window in days, counting back from today (inclusive). E.g. 30 = last 30 days, 90 = last 90 days. Any value in range works — not limited to a fixed set of buckets. Today is excluded from the series.

category_id.description: Restrict to one category id, e.g. 'MLA1051'. Empty string = all categories.

metrics.description: Five daily series: visits, gmv, si (units), items, convertion (%). One point per day, today excluded.

points.description: Points as 'YYYY-MM-DD value' strings, oldest first. 'convertion' values have 2 decimals; all other metrics are whole numbers.

currency.description: ISO code of the gmv series.

name: nubi_competition_seller_group_members
description:
Lists the sellers inside one saved seller group, with the competitor hash needed by nubi_competition_seller_metrics, nubi_competition_seller_items and nubi_competition_seller_evolution.

Use when: you need to see who is in a seller group, or need a seller_id_competitor.
Requires: a group_id from nubi_competition_seller_groups.
Note: member_code is an obfuscated hash, not a MercadoLibre seller id, and the output has no seller nickname.
Note: is_self=true marks the seller's own account added to the group — nubi_competition_seller_metrics and nubi_competition_seller_evolution reject its member_code.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

group_id.description: Group id exactly as returned by nubi_competition_seller_groups — never the group name or its position in the list.
Id of the group (echo of the input).

group_description.description: Description of the group; often empty.

is_favorite.description: True when the group is marked as favorite.

member_code.description: Obfuscated competitor hash. Use as seller_id_competitor in nubi_competition_seller_metrics/nubi_competition_seller_items/nubi_competition_seller_evolution.

active.description: True when the member is active in the group.

tracking_information.description: Backend tracking flag; its meaning is not documented.

is_self.description: True when member_code is the authenticated seller's own plain numeric seller_id instead of a competitor hash (the seller added their own account to this group). Using this member_code as seller_id_competitor in any downstream nubi_competition_seller_* tool fails with a 500 — plain numeric IDs are rejected and there is no confirmed way to query your own seller data through this family.

has_more.description: True when more members are available with offset.

name: nubi_competition_seller_group_metrics
description:
Totals for a whole saved seller group over a day window: combined revenue, combined units and average ticket, plus the window's dates. One summary for the group, not a per-seller breakdown.

Use when: the user wants the overall size of a competitor group's activity.
Requires: a group_id from nubi_competition_seller_groups. For one competitor use nubi_competition_seller_metrics.
Note: days is an exact day count ending today; date_from/date_to echo the window.
Note: total_gmv and total_units are rounded display strings such as '539.7M' or '23.9K', not exact numbers.
See nubi://nubi_rules/obfuscation — competitor figures are approximate.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

group_id.description: Group id exactly as returned by nubi_competition_seller_groups — never the group name or its position in the list.

days.description: Size of the analysis window in days, counting back from today (inclusive). E.g. 30 = last 30 days, 90 = last 90 days. Any value in range works — not limited to a fixed set of buckets.

category_id.description: Restrict to one category id, e.g. 'MLA1051'. Empty string = all categories.

total_gmv.description: Sum of the members' revenue in the window, as a rounded display string ('539.7M'), in 'currency'. Not exact.

total_units.description: Sum of the members' units, as a rounded display string ('23.9K').

avg_ticket.description: total revenue / total units, computed before rounding, in 'currency'. null when no units.

member_count.description: Members with data in the response that were added up.

currency.description: ISO code of the amounts: always the site's currency.

name: nubi_competition_seller_groups
description:
Lists the seller's saved groups of OTHER SELLERS (competitors / stores they follow): group id, name, description, favorite flag and member count.

Use when: the user mentions a saved group of sellers, or you need a group_id for nubi_competition_seller_group_members or nubi_competition_seller_group_metrics.
Not for: groups of publications — use nubi_competition_publication_groups.
Note: pass group_id exactly as returned, never the list position.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

group_id.description: Group id — pass it exactly as is to the members and metrics tools.

group_description.description: Description of the group; often empty.

is_favorite.description: True for the group marked as favorite.

has_more.description: True when more groups are available with offset.

name: nubi_competition_seller_items
description:
One competitor's publications over a day window, ordered by revenue: title, revenue, units, price, condition, catalog flag, leaf category id, shipping flags, listing type and brand.

Use when: the user wants to see what a specific competitor sells and which of their publications perform best.
Requires: seller_id_competitor from nubi_competition_seller_group_members (an obfuscated hash, not a MercadoLibre id).
Note: gmv and units are rounded display strings such as '1.9M'. total is how many publications the window returned; page with limit/offset.
Note: this is the heaviest competition call — large windows on big catalogs can hit the 120 s timeout.
Note: categories come as ids only; nubi_competition_seller_metrics names the top-level categories.
See nubi://nubi_rules/obfuscation — competitor figures are approximate.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

seller_id_competitor.description: member_code of a competitor from nubi_competition_seller_group_members — an obfuscated hash, not a MercadoLibre id or nickname.

category_id.description: Restrict to one category id, e.g. 'MLA1051'. Empty string = all categories.

days.description: Size of the analysis window in days, counting back from today (inclusive). E.g. 30 = last 30 days, 90 = last 90 days. Any value in range works — not limited to a fixed set of buckets. Large windows on a competitor with a big catalog risk the 120s request timeout — this is the heaviest call in the domain (a ~8600-item catalog over 90D took ~1m51s in testing).

in_cache.description: If true, only reads a result already stored for this competitor and window; if none is stored, the call fails with a backend error — call again with false. A stored result comes back much faster.

limit.description: Max publications to return, taken in GMV-descending order. No server-side pagination is available for this data.

publications.description: The competitor's publications in the window, highest revenue first.

item_id.description: Hashed publication id — not MercadoLibre's public id.

gmv.description: Revenue in the window, as a rounded display string ('1.9M'). Approximate (obfuscated).

units.description: Units in the window, as a display string. Approximate.

category_id.description: Leaf category id (no name — nubi_competition_seller_metrics names the top-level categories).

listing_type_name.description: Listing type name in the site's language, e.g. 'Clásica', 'Premium'.

total.description: Publications the backend returned for the window (before limit/offset).

has_more.description: True when more are available with offset.

currency.description: ISO code of the amounts (site's currency).

name: nubi_competition_seller_metrics
description:
Snapshot of one competitor over a day window: revenue, units, visits, items, average ticket and conversion; revenue split by top-level category (with names and share %); and the Pareto split (how many publications make 80% of revenue and how many make the rest).

Use when: the user wants a quick performance summary of one competitor, or where their sales concentrate.
Requires: seller_id_competitor from nubi_competition_seller_group_members.
Next step: nubi_competition_seller_evolution for the daily trend, nubi_competition_seller_items for the publications.
Note: gmv and units are rounded display strings such as '58.7M'. days is an exact day count ending today.
See nubi://nubi_rules/pareto and nubi://nubi_rules/obfuscation.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID of the querying account — not a group member or competitor. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Only needed if the user has multiple linked accounts.

seller_id_competitor.description: member_code of a competitor from nubi_competition_seller_group_members — an obfuscated hash, not a MercadoLibre id or nickname. Entries with is_self=true are rejected.

category_id.description: Restrict to one category id, e.g. 'MLA1051'. Empty string = all categories.

days.description: Size of the analysis window in days, counting back from today (inclusive). E.g. 30 = last 30 days, 90 = last 90 days. Any value in range works — not limited to a fixed set of buckets.

in_cache.description: Has no effect on the result: true and false return the same data.

gmv.description: Competitor revenue in the window, as a rounded display string ('58.7M'). Approximate.

units.description: Units in the window, as a display string ('3.4K').

items.description: Value of the 'items' daily series (see nubi_competition_seller_evolution) on the last day of the window. Not the number of publications with sales — see pareto for that.

avg_ticket.description: gmv / units. None when units is 0.

convertion.description: Conversion in the window, in % (8.84 = 8.84%). The field name's spelling comes from the backend.

category_id.description: Echo of the category filter; null when no filter was passed.

last_update.description: When the backend last refreshed this competitor's data.

gmv.description: Competitor revenue in that category, as a number (approximate).

share_pct.description: gmv / total_gmv * 100 across all categories in this breakdown.

anyOf.description: 80/20 split of the competitor's catalog by accumulated GMV — see nubi://nubi_rules/pareto.

pareto_items.description: Publications that together make ~80% of revenue.

pareto_value_share_pct.description: Share of revenue those publications make, in % (about 80).

long_tail_items.description: Publications that make the remaining revenue.

long_tail_value_share_pct.description: Share of revenue of the long tail, in % (about 20).

pareto.description: None when there is no item distribution data for this range.

name: nubi_evaluate_categories
description:
The authenticated seller's own categories for a date range: the seller's revenue in each, the seller's ranking position in that category, and a Pareto flag marking the categories that together make 80% of the seller's revenue.

Use when: the user asks about their own category performance — where they earn most, where they lead (position 1–2) and where they are weak.
Not for: browsing the market. It only returns categories where the seller sold; use meli_category_explorer for the whole category tree.
Limitation: closed months only; if the requested month is the current one and has no data yet, it falls back to the previous month (period_fallback).
See nubi://nubi_rules/pareto for how to use the pareto flag.

date_from.description: Start of the evaluation period (inclusive), e.g. 2026-04-01.

date_to.description: End of the evaluation period (inclusive), e.g. 2026-04-30.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to evaluate. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts.

limit.description: Max categories to return. Omit for all.

sort_by.description: 'revenue' = the seller's revenue, highest first; 'ranking' = the seller's position in each category, best first.

categories.description: One row per category where the seller sold in the period.

path.description: Category ids from top level to leaf joined by '-'.

revenue.description: The seller's own revenue in this category for the period, in local currency.

ranking.description: The seller's position among the category's sellers (1 = leader). null when unranked.

pareto.description: True if this category is among the ones that make 80% of the seller's revenue (the 80/20 split's pareto subset) — see nubi://nubi_rules/pareto.

period_fallback.description: True when the requested period had no data and an earlier month was used.

name: meli_market_rankings
description:
Top-100 MercadoLibre ranking for one category and month, in one dimension: items, brands, catalog products, sellers or official stores, ranked by revenue (ranking_type='gmv') or units ('si').

Use when: the user asks who or what leads a category — top products, brands, sellers or official stores — or how concentrated it is.
Note: a ranking proves a position only within its own dimension. Leading the brand ranking is not the category's size and is not "dominating the market" — compare more than one dimension before concluding.
Note: with topic='items' titles come truncated; request topic='catalog' for full product names.
Requires: a category id at any level — call meli_category_explorer if unknown.
Limitation: closed months only; if the requested month is the current one and has no data yet, it falls back to the previous month (period_fallback). Raises a guidance error if the category is not found.
See nubi://nubi_rules/obfuscation — seller figures are approximate, not exact.

date.description: First day of the month to read, e.g. 2026-09-01. Only closed months have data; if this is the current month and it has no data yet, the tool falls back to the previous month (see period_fallback).

topic.description: Ranking dimension: items = best-selling listings, brands = brands (not seller accounts), catalog = catalog products, seller = seller accounts, official_store = official stores. Use seller, not brands, for 'who are the top sellers'. The output reports official_store as dimension 'os'.

ranking_type.description: 'gmv' ranks by revenue; 'si' ranks by units sold.

category_id.description: Category id or the full path from meli_category_explorer, e.g. 'MLA1246' or 'MLA1246-MLA1263-MLA414007'. A bare id is resolved to its full path. A hyphenated value is used as given, so pass the complete path — a partial or truncated path is not repaired and fails. Must belong to the seller's site (MLA, MLB, …).

limit.description: Max positions to return (1–100). The ranking has at most 100 positions.

offset.description: Positions to skip. Only offsets below 100 return rows.

currency.description: 'local' = site currency, 'usd' = US dollars. Use 'usd' to compare months without inflation.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to use. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts. Get the linked ids from nubi_user_info.

items.description: Ranking rows, best first. What a row is depends on 'dimension'.

position.description: Position in the ranking; 1 is first.

name.description: Listing title, brand, catalog product, seller alias or official store, depending on 'dimension'. With dimension 'items' it is cut at 40 characters, mid-word — request topic='catalog' for full names.

full.description: True when the listing uses Mercado Libre Full.

growth_gmv.description: Revenue change versus the PREVIOUS MONTH, in % — never versus the same month last year.

growth_si.description: Units change versus the previous month, in %.

sellers_quantity.description: Sellers competing in the entry. Only filled for brands and catalog; 0 for items and seller.

items_quantity.description: Listings grouped under the entry (brand, catalog product, store). 0 for dimension 'items'.

catalog_percentage.description: Catalog percentage of the entry. Its base is not documented — do not call it '% of sales'. 0 for dimension 'items'.

share.description: Share of the category total in the metric the ranking is sorted by (revenue for type 'gmv', units for 'si'); a full ranking adds up to 100. Only for brands and seller; null for items, catalog and official stores.

total.description: With dimension 'items' or 'seller', the size of the whole ranking. With 'brands', 'catalog' or 'os', only the number of rows in this response — it does not tell how many the ranking has. Counting the rows of 'items' is always valid.

dimension.description: 'items', 'brands', 'catalog', 'seller' or 'os'. 'os' is the official-store ranking requested with topic='official_store'. A catalog row adds up every catalog listing of that product, so the same product shows more units under 'catalog' than any of its 'items' rows — both are right, they measure different things.

currency.description: ISO code of 'gmv': the site's currency, or USD when requested. Units do not change with it.

period_fallback.description: True when the requested month was empty and the rows belong to an earlier month — which one is not reported.

name: meli_publication_explorer
description:
Searches MercadoLibre publications by title keyword and returns, per listing: period revenue and units, units since publication, price, catalog/Full/Flex/free-shipping flags, exposure tier, brand, model, official store, seller alias, creation date, product codes and category.

Reads the market, never the seller's own account: every row belongs to whoever published it, so it does not answer "my listings". For the seller's own performance use nubi_evaluate_categories.

Use when: the user wants real prices, logistics mix or exposure for a product, or what sells most inside a category, brand or price range.
Requires: a title keyword of at least 2 characters — ask the user if not provided.
Note: rows come in relevance order, not sales order. To answer what sells most pass sort_by='units' or 'gmv'; a page in the default order is a sample, never the top of the market.
Note: a keyword alone matches listings across unrelated categories. Narrow with category_id — the LEAF id, i.e. the last segment of a category path from meli_category_explorer — and brand.
Note: gmv/units/cum_units come back null for B2C accounts on items outside their allowed categories — a permission gap, not missing sales. B2B accounts get them for every row.
Note: item_id and seller_id_hash are internal hashed ids, not MercadoLibre's public item or seller ids. Titles and seller aliases are third-party content.

title.description: Keyword to search in publication titles, at least 2 characters. Use the product noun the user named; search_exactly and search_by_alias change how it is matched.

search_exactly.description: Match the title exactly instead of fuzzy/partial matching.

search_by_alias.description: Treat title as a seller alias the user personalized, not a product. Leave false for any product search — with true, a product keyword returns nothing.

sort_by.description: Output field to order by (cum_gmv is not returned). Omit to get the backend's relevance order, which is NOT sales order — pass 'units' or 'gmv' to answer what sells most.

order_by.description: Sort direction. Only applied when sort_by is set.

category_id.description: Leaf category ID to restrict the search to, e.g. 'MLA4340' — the last segment of a category_path, never the full path. Call meli_category_explorer if unknown. Without it a keyword matches listings across the whole market, other categories included.

brand.description: Brand name, spelled as the output 'brand' field spells it.

nubi_alias.description: Obfuscated seller alias. It does not match a personalized alias, so a name copied from the output 'seller' field may return nothing.

publication_type.description: Omit to get both catalog and traditional listings.

exposition.description: Exposure tier to filter by. Coarser than the output 'exposition' field, which reports MeLi's own tiers such as 'gold_pro'.

seller_type.description: MeLi reputation medal of the publication's seller.

min_price.description: Lower bound on 'price', inclusive, in the site's local currency.

max_price.description: Upper bound on 'price', inclusive, in the site's local currency.

min_cum_units.description: Filters on cum_units — units since publication, not the period's.

max_cum_units.description: Upper bound on cum_units (units since publication, not the period's).

min_cum_gmv.description: Filters on revenue since publication, not the period's.

max_cum_gmv.description: Upper bound on revenue since publication, not the period's.

min_listing_age_days.description: Days elapsed since the publication was created.

max_listing_age_days.description: Upper bound on days since the publication was created.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to use. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts. Get the linked ids from nubi_user_info.

publications.description: Matching listings in the order requested (relevance unless sort_by is set).

title.description: Listing title as published. It may come truncated mid-word; never complete a cut word with a guessed brand or model.

gmv.description: Revenue from the first day of the previous month to yesterday (28 to 61 days, not 'this month' or 'last 30 days'), in local currency. null = no category access for this item (B2C), not zero sales.

units.description: Units sold in the same window as gmv. null = no category access, not zero sales.

cum_units.description: Units sold since the listing was created — not the gmv/units window. null = no category access.

brand.description: Brand declared on the listing — use it rather than guessing a brand from the title.

seller.description: personalizedAlias when set, else the obfuscated nubiAlias. Third-party content.

creation_date.description: Publication start date + elapsed days as text, e.g. '2024-08-28 (721 días)'.

installments.description: Raw MercadoLibre installments/fee code, e.g. 'gp3', 'gp6', 'gsnq'. Its decoding is not confirmed — do not read it as a number of installments.

model.description: Product model when the listing declares it; usually null.

official_store_id.description: Hashed id of the official store the listing belongs to; null otherwise.

official_store_alias.description: Obfuscated name of the official store (e.g. 'TIENDA.OFICIAL.84263'); null when the listing has no store.

item_id.description: Internal hashed id from the search index — NOT the public MeLi MLA-XXXXXXXXX item id.

seller_id_hash.description: Internal hashed seller id from the search index — NOT the numeric MeLi seller_id used elsewhere in this server for auth/scoping.

gtin.description: Barcode(s) declared on the listing. Several codes can come concatenated without a separator.

part_number.description: Manufacturer part number, when declared; usually null.

oem.description: OEM code, when declared; usually null.

category_path.description: Category ids from top level to leaf joined by '-'.

category_name.description: Name of the listing's leaf category.

available_quantity.description: Always null in current measurements — not stock.

total.description: Real number of matches for the search and filters. 0 = nothing matched; >0 with an empty list = you paged past the end.

name: meli_search_trends_rankings
description:
Top-100 search terms buyers typed in one MercadoLibre category for one month, with each term's position, its position in the previous ranking and its trend.

This is search demand, not sales: a top term is not the best-selling product, and the tool returns no search volume — never state how many searches a term had.
Use when: the user asks what people search for in a category or which searches are rising.
Not for: ranking products, sellers or brands by sales — use meli_market_rankings.
Requires: a category id at any level — call meli_category_explorer if unknown.
Limitation: closed months only; if the requested month is the current one and has no data yet, it falls back to the previous month (period_fallback).

date.description: First day of the month to read, e.g. 2026-09-01. Only closed months have data; if this is the current month and it has no data yet, the tool falls back to the previous month (see period_fallback).

category_id.description: Category id or the full path from meli_category_explorer, e.g. 'MLA1246' or 'MLA1246-MLA1263-MLA414007'. A bare id is resolved to its full path. A hyphenated value is used as given, so pass the complete path — a partial or truncated path is not repaired and fails. Must belong to the seller's site (MLA, MLB, …).

limit.description: Max terms to return (1–100). The ranking has at most 100 positions.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to use. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts. Get the linked ids from nubi_user_info.

position.description: Position by searches; 1 is the most searched. A rank, not a magnitude.

search_term.description: What buyers typed, typos and abbreviations included. Quote it as is.

ranking_trend.description: 'GoingUp', 'GoingDown' or 'Stable' versus the previous period. It does not always match the change between position_before and position.

position_before.description: Position in the previous period. A rank, not a magnitude.

total.description: Number of terms in the whole ranking, not the rows returned in this response.

period_fallback.description: True when the requested month was empty and the terms belong to an earlier month — which one is not reported.

name: nubi_seller_info
description:
Account details for one MercadoLibre seller: plan, plan due date, site, currency, Nubimetrics account id, competition slots, segment (b2b/b2c) and the categories it is allowed to query.

Use when: you need a seller's currency, plan or allowed categories before calling a category tool, or the user asks about their plan.
Note: a b2c account is granted top-level categories and everything below them; a b2b account is granted specific categories one level down or more, so asking for a parent of a granted category is rejected (e.g. allowed MLA1002 but not its parent MLA1000).
Note: nubi_category_market_size and nubi_category_market_structure resolve access from another source and can reject a category listed here.
Use nubi_user_info to list the seller_ids linked to the user.

seller_id.description: MercadoLibre seller ID to use. Defaults to the authenticated user's main account. Pass a different value only if the user has multiple linked accounts — see nubi_user_info's linked_sellers.
MercadoLibre seller id of the resolved account.

currency.description: ISO code of the site's local currency.

account_id.description: Nubi account GUID (IdCuentaNubi) this seller belongs to.

competition_slots.description: How many competitors the plan lets the account save.

category_segment.description: Inferred access segment ('b2b' or 'b2c') — see nubi_category_forecast etc. for how this gates category_path access. Heuristic, not an officially confirmed value.

allowed_categories.description: Categories this seller is currently entitled to query with category_path tools. Empty means no category-scoped tool call will currently succeed for this seller. A grant covers its whole subtree.

path.description: Ids from top level to the granted category.

name: nubi_user_feedback
description:
Records feedback about the product, a tool, or the data it returned, for the Nubimetrics team to review. Does not change or fix anything in this conversation.

Use when: the user explicitly complains, praises, reports a bug, or suggests something; OR you notice a problem yourself while using another tool (e.g. implausible, inconsistent, or contradictory data) — you do not need the user to say something first.

Proactively suggest this tool when the user describes a problem that looks like a product/data issue rather than something you can resolve by retrying or adjusting parameters — offer to log it before dropping the issue.

Before calling: tell the user the summary you're about to submit (it's filed under their account) and get a quick go-ahead — don't submit silently.

Do not use when: the issue is something you can fix directly (e.g. wrong category_path — correct it and retry instead of filing feedback).

category.description: bug: something broke or returned wrong data. feature_request: the user wants new functionality. data_quality: the numbers/data look incorrect or inconsistent, not a code bug. general: anything else (praise, complaint, unstructured comment).

summary.description: Your own synthesis of the issue, written in third person. You do not need a verbatim user complaint to write this — infer it from the conversation, including problems you noticed yourself (e.g. a tool returned implausible or inconsistent data).

user_quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the user's own message that supports the summary above. Omit if the feedback originates purely from your own observation.

tool_name.description: The tool this feedback refers to, if applicable. Omit for general feedback.

received.description: Always true when the feedback was stored.

feedback_id.description: Id of the stored feedback record.

name: nubi_user_info
description:
Identity of the authenticated user: email, name, user type, status, main seller account, and every MercadoLibre seller account linked to it (seller_id, nickname, site, which one is main).

Use when: you need to know who the user is, or which seller_id values exist before passing one to nubi_seller_info or to any tool's seller_id.
Not for: plan, currency or allowed categories — use nubi_seller_info.

seller_id.description: Main account's seller_id — see linked_sellers for others.

linked_sellers.description: Every seller account linked to the user, the main one included.

seller_id.description: Seller id of that account.
